model_annotation: Figure 3(a) illustrates the inference time measured for the baseline Llama models and MambaLlama models at each batch size. The x-axis is labeled "Batch size" and is linear, ranging from 0 to 300 with tick labels at 0, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, and 300. The y-axis is labeled "Inference time (seconds)" and is linear, ranging from 0 to 10 with tick labels at 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10. A solid blue line with triangular markers represents Llama-1B, starting at 5.8 seconds at a batch size of 0 and decreasing to 3.5 seconds at a batch size of 300. A dashed red line with circular markers represents MambaLlama-1B, starting at 5.8 seconds at a batch size of 0 and decreasing to 3.2 seconds at a batch size of 300.
